seoDescription: Petrina Salema's practice in Vienna. Homes and hospitality spaces, a few projects a year, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling.
hook: People usually ask for a nicer room. What they need is a room that shapes life toward how they want to live.
body: I help people fix the rooms they live in, and the ones guests pay to stay in. I started this practice in Vienna in 2021, after years studying interior design and working in architecture studios. Most projects run one to three months, from the plan through materials, sourcing, and styling. Only a few each year, in Vienna, abroad, and remotely.

principles.title: Daily life
principles.body: If it only looks good in photos, it is not finished. The room has to hold up on ordinary days, including cleaning, storage, and how people actually move.

principles.title: A few projects a year
principles.body: There is only room for a few at a time. That pace is how each project gets careful attention from first plan to final styling.

principles.title: Home and hospitality
principles.body: Your own place, or a place that hosts guests. Either way the work is the same. Rest, people over, somewhere quiet to think, and a plan that survives real use.

ctaLede: Start with a fit call. Bring the floor plan if you have one. In thirty minutes we will know whether a full project or a Jumpstart hour is the right next step.
